title: Himalayas and Sierra Nevada compare table
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y4 lesson 8 (Himalayas and Sierra Nevada compare table (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 8: The Himalayas and the Sierra Nevada. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: The Himalayas
points: Asia: Nepal, India, China, Bhutan, Pakistan

keywords.def: the world's highest range, in Asia
a mountain range in California, USA
find what is the same and different

questions.q: About how many times higher is Everest than Mount Whitney?
Which country is the Sierra Nevada in?
Give one thing both ranges have.
questions.a: Snowy peaks (or rivers that start there)

questions.q: Core: Complete the compare table and write two same and two different sentences.
questions.a: For example: Both have snow; the Himalayas are higher; they are on different continents

questions.q: Extend: Why might the Himalayas be colder at the top?
questions.a: They are much higher, and it gets colder as you go up

questions.q: Stretch: Use a Venn diagram to show three more facts.

questions.a: B) Everest. Everest is about twice as high as Mount Whitney.

questions.q: Big question: which range would you explore and why?
questions.a: Either, with a reason using facts from the lesson
